tasks.task_name: Create a multi-section document and verify its persisted content
tool_calls:
files.write({"content": "# LMMs Architecture

The Local Model Machine Studio (LMMs) architecture is designed to host and execute multimodal large language models within a controlled sandboxed environment. It integrates vision-language capabilities with a modular runtime that supports tool use, document indexing, and secure code execution. The architecture emphasizes separation of concerns between model inference, tool orchestration, and workspace isolation.

## Core Runtime Pipeline

The core runtime pipeline manages the end-to-end flow from user request to model response. It includes input preprocessing, multimodal encoding, model inference, tool invocation routing, and output post-processing. Tool calls are dispatched through a structured interface that validates arguments and executes permitted operations such as file reads, web searches, and terminal commands within the sandbox.

## Security & Sandboxing

Security is enforced through workspace boundary restrictions and capability-based tool access. All file system operations are confined to the active workspace directory, and network access is limited to approved endpoints. Code execution occurs in an isolated environment with no persistent privilege escalation, ensuring that model-generated actions cannot compromise the host system.", "path": "benchmark_architecture.md"})
